findings.comment: Site plan does not document that the proposed 39-unit multifamily residential project is within one-half mile walking distance of a public transit route per LDC § 25-1-703(B)(4). The Project Location Map and submitted materials do not demonstrate transit proximity. No approved waiver from the director has been provided. Applicant must either provide documentation confirming the site is within one-half mile of a public transit route (e.g., Capital Metro route map, walking distance analysis) or submit an approved transit proximity waiver from the director prior to site plan approval.
